wrong.comment: Brackets are not always the legal name. Many names have the Pty Ltd name OUTSIDE the brackets, e.g. "Thermo Fisher Australia Pty Ltd (Thermo Fisher Scientific Australia Pty Ltd)", and 44% of names have no brackets at all.
